caption: The drawing shows a rectangular wooden sign hanging from two metal hooks attached to a horizontal piece of wood. The sign has a weathered appearance, with visible streaks and discoloration in shades of light brown and beige on the main surface. It is bordered by a frame with worn green and reddish-brown coloring, showing signs of age. The text on the sign is in bold, black capital letters; the top line, slightly curved, reads "THE 8 MILE," and the bottom, much larger and straight, reads "HOUSE." The background is an off-white or cream color, and the artist's signature "Edward J. Reynolds – 41" appears in orange in the lower right corner outside the sign.
title: Tavern Sign
